prompt: Award-winning luxury fashion campaign photography for Monavi Collection ("Wear Your Story"). Charming 7-year-old Indian boy child model with cheerful spirited grin, natural relaxed posture, joyful celebration expression, wearing premium bespoke Kurta Pajama crafted from rich Raw Silk, Chanderi Cotton, Linen Silk, Jacquard in shades of Midnight Black, Royal Navy, Ivory Cream. Intricate tailoring, pristine seam lines, tactile fabric weave, authentic drapery and natural folds. Setting: Sun-drenched botanical garden lawn or bright airy sunroom with natural light. Lighting: Bright, soft, diffused daylight with gentle pastel reflections. Camera: Shot on Hasselblad H6D-100c medium format, 85mm f/1.4 lens, shallow depth of field, authentic filmic color rendition. Skin & Anatomy: Natural human skin pores, fine skin texture, anatomically perfect hands and fingers, realistic fabric texture, ultra-high resolution 8k. Composition rule: Model is positioned strictly in the right 55% of the frame. The left 45% has clean, unobtrusive architectural backdrop tones for typography overlay.
